explanation.en: Water runs “from the gutter to the ground” — the channel along the roof → gutter. The “roof” is already drawn.
explanation.kk: Су «from the gutter to the ground» ағады — шатыр жиегіндегі науа → gutter. «Roof» сызбада бар.
explanation.ru: Вода идёт «from the gutter to the ground» — жёлоб вдоль крыши → gutter. «Roof» уже нарисована.

RT-GT-DL-04-Q1.quote: carries water from the gutter to the ground

explanation.en: “A pipe called a downpipe” → downpipe, one word.
explanation.kk: «A pipe called a downpipe» → downpipe, бір сөз.
explanation.ru: «A pipe called a downpipe» → downpipe, одним словом.

RT-GT-DL-04-Q2.quote: A pipe called a downpipe carries water from the gutter to the ground

explanation.en: The device on the downpipe that “sends some of the water into the butt” is “a diverter”. Answer: diverter.
explanation.kk: Құбырда суды бөшкеге бұратын құрылғы бар — «a diverter fitted to this pipe». Жауап diverter.
explanation.ru: На водосточной трубе стоит устройство, которое «sends some of the water into the butt», — «a diverter». Ответ diverter.

RT-GT-DL-04-Q3.quote: a diverter fitted to this pipe sends some of the water into the butt

explanation.en: On top of the butt is a lid: “The butt should have a lid to keep out leaves and insects”. Answer: lid.
explanation.kk: Бөшкенің үстінде — қақпақ: «The butt should have a lid to keep out leaves and insects». Жауап lid.
explanation.ru: Сверху бочки — крышка: «The butt should have a lid to keep out leaves and insects». Ответ lid.

RT-GT-DL-04-Q4.quote: The butt should have a lid to keep out leaves and insects

explanation.en: The tap is easier to use “if the butt stands on a raised base”. “Raised” is in the label, so the answer is base.
explanation.kk: Шүмекті пайдалану «if the butt stands on a raised base» болса оңай. «Raised» жазуда тұр, жауап base.
explanation.ru: Кран удобнее, «if the butt stands on a raised base». «Raised» уже в подписи, ответ base.

RT-GT-DL-04-Q5.quote: if the butt stands on a raised base
